heading: Reactor configuration
reported_value: gliding arc plasmatron (Nunnally design); outlet 26 mm long, ID 7.07 mm; basket ~5 g carbon at anode exit, 0-60 mm; silo ~200 cm3 fresh carbon; stainless mesh; thermocouples at 15 and 35 mm
evidence_excerpt_or_description: The basket was filled with ca. 5 g of carbon pellets for each plasma run ... A silo (stainless steel) containing fresh carbon was inserted ... approx. 200 cm3
notes: charcoal 1: Norit PK 1-3 (1-3 mm, steam activated); charcoal 2: C3014 (250-850 um); BET ~705 m2/g

heading: Operating conditions
evidence_excerpt_or_description: We used pure CO2 as reactant gas in the plasma reactor (Air Liquide, purity 99.995%; flow rate kept constant at 10 Ln.min-1)
notes: 'Ln' normally 0 C; SEI converted with 24.5 L/mol (E009)

heading: Performance indicators

heading: Performance indicators
